description: HP-21 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) for the Barsar sub-division in Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh. It functions under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Barsar, handling vehicle registration, driving licenses, and other transport-related services for the region.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Barsar, District Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh
